purpose: Distinguish Personal Instructions delivery failure from delivered-but-not-followed behavior without treating a failed behavior alone as proof of a product injection failure.

canary_contract.harmless_instruction: On the first assistant reply in a new chat, append the unique marker exactly once.
canary_contract.first_user_turn: A normal prompt that does not contain or describe the marker.
canary_contract.safety: This fixture is an offline classifier only. It must not edit Personal Instructions, memory, Settings, personality, or other live user configuration. Any live canary setup requires separate explicit user authorization.

classifications.delivery_failure_proven: UI marker is confirmed, fresh-chat setup is uncontaminated, effective context is directly observed absent, and canary behavior is absent.
classifications.delivered_but_not_followed: The marker is directly observed in effective context but the harmless behavior is absent; do not blame delivery.
classifications.delivery_and_behavior_confirmed: The marker is directly observed in effective context and the harmless behavior is observed.
classifications.effective_delivery_confirmed_context_uno: The unique behavior is observed without user restatement, supporting effective delivery while literal context presence remains unobserved.
classifications.undifferentiated_failure: Behavior is absent and effective context is unavailable; do not attribute the failure to delivery or assistant noncompliance.
classifications.inconsistent_observation: Behavior is observed while the same run claims the unique marker is absent from effective context; evidence must be reconciled before attribution.
classifications.invalid_setup: The chat is not fresh, the UI marker is not confirmed, or the marker leaked into the user turn.
